# Combining data by state to create one clean data table

## Loading data

```{r}
library(readr)
ASPP_Unit_File_2024 <- read_csv("ASPP_Unit_File_2024.csv")
View(ASPP_Unit_File_2024)

happiest_states_2026 <- read_csv("happiest-states-2026.csv")
View(happiest_states_2026)

library(readxl)
sahie_2024_csv <- read_excel("sahie_2024.csv.xlsx")
View(sahie_2024_csv)

table_18_spm_opm_state_by_age <- read_excel("table_18_spm_opm_state_by_age.xlsx")
View(table_18_spm_opm_state_by_age)
```
